experiment: IMAGE WAVE V4 — four axes, one frozen pre-registration

axes.E1_judge_axis: CLIP-b32 vs DINOv2-base identity agreement across ALL existing artifacts (v1+v2+v3 candidates). Question: does the identity gate depend on one judge's opinion?
axes.E2_structure_sweep: v3.1: cn in {0.45,0.6} x fresh seeds 101-104 (lucineer), cn06 x casey/jev/mmx (NEW subjects), base controls; STRUCTURE DRIFT metric (fraction of edge pixels changed vs source) replaces saturated edge-IoU; targets := measured source dial readings (anchor-relative bias, hand-picked targets removed from loop)
axes.E3_cross_identity_control: NEGATIVE CONTROL that must scream: lucineer edges -> casey init, casey edges -> lucineer init (cn06). The identity gate must refuse these morphs.
axes.E4_style_under_structure: cn06 pins geometry while style prompts vary (watercolor, neon-vector) vs same styles with NO structure constraint. Doctrine test: structure constraint buys style freedom.

claims.claim: Spearman(CLIP, DINOv2) identity >= 0.85 across existing artifacts
structure drift: cn arms < base arm, paired per subject (new metric discriminates where IoU saturated)
bias win reproduces: lucineer |machine_vs_organic bias| <= 5.0 pooled across cn 0.45+0.6 (v3: cn06 -4.0)
>= 1 accepted (JEV noul >= 0.6) for at least 3 of 4 subjects incl one NEW subject
all cross-identity candidates fail identity floor: mean identity (vs their own init) < 0.80
claims.honest: if the gate ACCEPTS morphs, record FAIL - gate is weak, that is a real finding

claims.claim: identity under style shift: cn arms >= 0.78 mean AND cn > base paired per style
